doctor.title: Anya environment check
doctor.terminal.ssh_target: the desktop terminal that will start Anya
doctor.unhealthy: Result: fix the items above, then start Anya again.
doctor.engine.name: Speech engine
doctor.engine.unknown.fix: Pick an engine in the settings window, or set [voice] engine in {config}.
doctor.engine.invalid_value: {engine}: {field} has a value it cannot use
doctor.engine.fix: Fill in the engine's settings in the settings window, or under [voice.engine_configs] in {config}.
doctor.clipboard_tool.name: Clipboard tool
doctor.clipboard_tool.fix: Install the {package} package so {tool} is on PATH.
doctor.paste_keys.name: Pasting into the focused field
doctor.paste_keys.not_granted: Accessibility permission is off; text is copied but not pasted
doctor.paste_keys.not_granted.fix: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility, turn on {terminal}, then restart Anya.
doctor.paste_keys.wtype: wtype at {path} (if pasting does nothing, grant write access to /dev/uinput as a fallback)
doctor.paste_keys.denied: wtype is not installed and /dev/uinput is not writable: {error}
doctor.paste_keys.denied.fix: Install wtype, or give your user write access to /dev/uinput with a udev rule and group.
doctor.paste_keys.kde_denied: KDE Plasma needs /dev/uinput (wtype does not work there), and it is not writable: {error}
doctor.paste_keys.kde_denied.fix: Run: sudo groupadd -f uinput; sudo usermod -aG uinput $USER; write /etc/udev/rules.d/70-uinput.rules containing KERNEL=="uinput", MODE="0660", GROUP="uinput", OPTIONS+="static_node=uinput"; then sudo modprobe uinput && sudo udevadm control --reload-rules && sudo udevadm trigger /dev/uinput, and log in again.
doctor.audio_input.name: Audio input
doctor.audio_input.none.fix: Connect a microphone, or on Linux check that ALSA sees one (`arecord -l`).
doctor.audio_input.denied: The system refused access to the input: {detail}
doctor.audio_input.denied.fix: On Linux, add yourself to the audio group: `sudo usermod -aG audio $USER`, then log in again. On macOS, allow the microphone in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Microphone.
doctor.audio_input.fix: Check the input device in your sound settings and try again.
doctor.microphone_permission.name: Microphone permission
doctor.microphone_permission.not_determi: Not asked yet; macOS will ask when recording starts
doctor.microphone_permission.fix: Turn on microphone access for {terminal} in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Microphone.
doctor.accessibility.name: Accessibility permission
doctor.accessibility.denied: Not granted. Global hotkeys and pasting need it
doctor.accessibility.fix: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility and turn on Anya
doctor.input_devices.name: Input device access
doctor.input_devices.not_in_group: Cannot read {device}; you are not in the input group
doctor.input_devices.not_in_group.fix: Run `sudo usermod -aG input $USER`, then log in again
doctor.input_devices.group_not_refreshed: Cannot read {device}; you joined the input group but this session predates it
Log out and back in (or reboot)
doctor.input_devices.no_input_group: Cannot read {device}; this system has no input group
doctor.input_devices.no_input_group.fix: Grant your user read access to /dev/input/event* (e.g. a udev rule)
doctor.input_devices.denied: Cannot read {device} although you are in the input group
doctor.input_devices.denied.fix: Check the permissions and ACLs on /dev/input/event*
doctor.x11_display.name: X display
doctor.x11_display.fix: Start Anya inside the X session
doctor.hotkeys.name: Global hotkeys
doctor.hotkeys.unsupported_desktop: Global hotkeys are not available on {desktop}
doctor.overlay_window_server.name: Window server session
doctor.overlay_window_server.present: A desktop session is available for the overlay.
doctor.overlay_window_server.missing: No desktop session: the recording overlay cannot be shown.
doctor.overlay_window_server.fix: Run Anya from a logged-in desktop session, not over SSH.
